question: How many days per year am I allowed to work as an international student in Germany without asking the employment agency?
reference_answer: 140 full days or 280 half days per year, without approval from the Federal Employment Agency.

question: Can international students in Türkiye work part-time, and does it depend on whether they are bachelor's or master's students?
reference_answer: Associate and undergraduate students can work part-time only after completing their first year of study; graduate students are not subject to that first-year restriction. A work permit is still required.

Work permit applications for graduate students enrolled in formal education programs will not be subject to the limitations mentioned in the first paragraph.
